ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Can Fin Homes Limited Q2 FY27 Earnings Call**  Can Fin Homes reported a significant drop in Q2 FY27 disbursements, reaching only INR2,375 crores, primarily due to operational disruptions from its Project Tejas IT transformation and a new Telangana regulation. Despite this substantial impact, management maintains its full-year disbursement guidance of INR13,000 crores and AUM growth of 13-14%, implying an exceptionally strong H2 is required to meet these targets. While liquidity (high LCR), NIM, and credit costs appear stable, the execution of this ambitious recovery plan in the latter half of the year will be a critical watchpoint.
